entry.description: stop the configurator echoing secret configuration values. A parameter whose name reads as a secret, such as `password` or `connectionString`, is now logged as `*****`, the connection string keeping only the keywords that name the server. This covers internal debugging, the documented first troubleshooting step, and the four setter-failure messages, which are written even without it (audit da18b6fd-f042, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
